rows.s_sql:
SET @prov_c := '%s';
SET	@id:= '%s';
SET @cat_id := '%s';
SET	@send :=  IF((SELECT active FROM sys_report WHERE cat_id = @cat_id and id = @id )=1,0,2);
SET @b_year:=(SELECT yearprocess FROM pk_byear LIMIT 1);
SET	@start_d:=concat(@b_year-1,'1001');
SET @end_d:=concat(@b_year,'0930');

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS s_dm_hba1c(
  id varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  hospcode varchar(5) NOT NULL,
  areacode varchar(8) NOT NULL,
  flag_sent varchar(1) DEFAULT NULL,
  date_com varchar(14) DEFAULT NULL,
  b_year varchar(4) NOT NULL,
  target int(9) DEFAULT 0,
  result int(9) DEFAULT 0,
  target1 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
  result1 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
  
PRIMARY KEY (id,hospcode,areacode,b_year),
	KEY (hospcode),
	KEY (areacode),
	KEY (b_year)
) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

DELETE FROM s_dm_hba1c WHERE id=@id AND b_year=(@b_year+543);

INSERT IGNORE INTO s_dm_hba1c 
(
SELECT @id,b.hospcode,b.areacode
,@send,DATE_FORMAT(now(),'%Y%m%d%H%i') as d_com,@b_year+543
,b.target,b.result
,a.target1,a.result1
FROM
(SELECT
p.check_hosp hospcode,p.check_vhid areacode
,COUNT(DISTINCT d.cid) target
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(d.ld_hba1c BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d ,d.cid,NULL )) result
FROM
t_dmht d 
INNER JOIN t_person_cid p ON d.cid=p.CID
WHERE d.cid IS NOT NULL AND d.type_dx in(2,3) AND p.check_typearea IN(1,3) 
AND p.NATION IN(99) AND p.DISCHARGE IN(9)
AND substr(p.check_vhid,1,2) IN(@prov_c)
GROUP BY p.check_hosp,p.check_vhid
) b LEFT JOIN (
	SELECT
		f.hospcode,concat(h.provcode,h.distcode,SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.subdistcode),-2) ,SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.mu),-2)) as areacode
		,COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(f.hospcode,'-',f.pid)) target1
		,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(f.ld_hba1c BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d ,CONCAT(f.hospcode,'-',f.pid),NULL )) result1
  FROM
	t_chronicfu f INNER JOIN t_dmht d ON f.cid=d.cid
	INNER JOIN chospital h ON f.hospcode=h.hoscode
	WHERE h.provcode in(@prov_c)  AND f.cid IS NOT NULL AND  d.type_dx in(2,3) AND d.NATION IN(99) 
	GROUP BY h.hoscode,areacode
) a ON b.hospcode = a.hospcode AND b.areacode=a.areacode
);

INSERT IGNORE INTO s_dm_hba1c 
(
SELECT 
	@id,f.hospcode,concat(h.provcode,h.distcode,SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.subdistcode),-2) ,SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.mu),-2)) as areacode
		,@send,DATE_FORMAT(now(),'%Y%m%d%H%i') as d_com,@b_year+543
		,NULL,NULL
		,COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(f.hospcode,'-',f.pid)) target1
		,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(f.ld_hba1c BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d ,CONCAT(f.hospcode,'-',f.pid),NULL )) result1
FROM
	t_chronicfu f INNER JOIN t_dmht d ON f.cid=d.cid
	INNER JOIN chospital h ON f.hospcode=h.hoscode
	WHERE h.provcode in(@prov_c)  AND f.cid IS NOT NULL AND  d.type_dx in(2,3) AND d.NATION IN(99) 
	GROUP BY h.hoscode,areacode
);

zone.query: SELECT h.zone_code as a_code, h.zone_name as a_name, sum("target") as "target", sum("result") as "result", sum("target1") as "target1", sum("result1") as "result1", sum("result_2") as "result_2", sum("result1_2") as "result1_2" FROM chospital_regis as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.hoscode = s.hospcode AND s.b_year = {{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON s.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} LEFT JOIN cmastercup ON s.hospcode = cmastercup.hsub WHERE ( h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}} ) AND ( h.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} ) AND ( h.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} ) AND ( h.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} ) AND ( h.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} ) AND ( h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) ) AND ( h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) ) AND ( h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) ) AND ( ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} ) AND ( cmastercup.hsub IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) ) and h.zone_code != '13' GROUP BY h.zone_code, h.zone_name ORDER BY h.zone_code
